title: solid-apps catalog manifest
description: One app.json per application directory. Used to populate the catalog landing page and let LLMs/agents discover what apps exist and which urn:solid types each handles.

name.description: Display name shown in the catalog.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what the app does.

entry.description: Relative path to the app's HTML entry point (typically ./index.html).

types.description: urn:solid: types this app reads, writes, or otherwise handles.

screenshot.description: Relative or absolute URL of a screenshot for the catalog.

source.description: URL of the app's source repository, if separate.
